mentions.name: Intelligent Workspace
mentions.description: A human-centered alternative to chatbots as the primary means of working with AI, designed as a workspace that accommodates a wide array of use cases where human interaction and engagement are essential for getting work done.
mentions.problem: Chatbots are currently the primary means of working with AI, which doesn't accommodate use cases where human interaction and engagement are essential.
mentions.source_excerpt:
"Intelligent Workspace":

https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=44627910

In lieu of chatbots as the primary means of working with AI.

This is an approach that is human centered and intended to accommodate a wide array of possible use cases where human interaction/engagement is essential for getting work done.
